verifiedAgainst.note: Verified: repository-wide instructions are .github/copilot-instructions.md. Path-specific instructions are NAME.instructions.md files within or below .github/instructions, carrying a required `applyTo` front-matter field with glob syntax. Also verified, and relevant to ADR-0013's base choice: Copilot reads AGENTS.md anywhere in the repository with nearest-in-tree precedence, plus CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md at the root — so the AGENTS.md base really is read natively here.
